## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg over 7 days | Counselling for adverse events |
| **G6PD Deficient - Mild-Moderate** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Counselling for adverse events |
| **G6PD Deficient - Severe** | No PQ |  |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25mg/kg over 14 days (maximum 15 mg) | Close medical supervision, counselling for adverse events |
